reviews.text: They are amazing at customer service ❤️

It was the first time I took my three dogs to Ilpet for a bath, and the experience was wonderful! 🥰🐶 From scheduling to delivery, everyone was very attentive, friendly, and careful. My girls came back beautiful, smelling great, and very well cared for! ❤️ The service was excellent, the price is fair, and you can see the affection the whole team has for the animals. We will definitely be back! I recommend them without hesitation! Congratulations to the entire team for the impeccable service and work! 🐾💕
I loved discovering this pet shop; my dog ​​looked beautiful and was calm during his bath. I recommend it.
I loved the grooming of my German Spitz. Highly skilled professionals. From now on, I will only take him to Andréa Miranda for grooming. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Bruno.

Today I took my dog ​​for a bath and grooming and I was impressed. From the first contact to the end, the service was impeccable. They treated my pet with great care, the grooming was exceptional, and he left visibly happy. Great environment and attentive staff the whole time. I highly recommend them!
I loved Sofia's grooming! Very careful! 1000/1000

I loved the service! ❤️🐶 They are super attentive, careful, and meticulous in every detail. Penelope looked beautiful after her bath and grooming! You can see the affection they have for our pets. I will definitely come back more often! 🥰✨
Thank you so much Elber, I loved Amora. She reminded me so much of my Ruby.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Mrs. Francisca. We are very happy to receive your comment! We work hard to provide well-being and health to all our little friends!
Great experience. Everyone was very kind and I noticed the care they give to the pets. We will definitely stay with you. Congratulations!
